title: Hawke's Bay Deals
meta_desc: Discover the best family deals in Hawke's Bay, including discounts on activities, accommodation, and travel insurance.
intro: Hawke's Bay is a hidden gem for family holidays, with its Art Deco city, gannet colonies, and beautiful beaches. With the right deals and discounts, you can have a fun and affordable holiday in this stunning region. Here are the best family deals in Hawke's Bay for August 2026.

sections.heading: Best-Value Activities
sections.body:
Some of the best-value activities in Hawke's Bay include the Cape Kidnappers Gannet Colony tour, priced from $40 per person, and the Napier Art Deco walk, which is free to do on your own.

Ocean Beach and Waimarama Beach are also great spots for swimming and sunbathing, and are free to visit.

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips
sections.body:
To save money on your family holiday in Hawke's Bay, consider visiting during the off-season, when prices are lower.

Also, book your activities and accommodation in advance to get the best prices, and look for package deals that include multiple activities or services.

sections.heading: Travel Insurance
